PhD Programs of the University of Bern 2025–2028
Within the scope of its multi-year planning, the Executive Board of the University of Bern has provided funds for the continuation of the internal funding program “PhD Programs of the University of Bern” for the period 2025–2028.
The purpose of the “PhD Programs of the University of Bern 2025–2028” is to offer high-quality, research-supporting educational programs that are conducive to developing and expanding research and interdisciplinary skills, thus equipping PhD students with excellent qualifications for a research-centered career in both academia and industry.
The following PhD programs are supported within the scope of the “PhD Programs of the University of Bern 2025–2028”:
Interdisciplinary PhD Program Classical Studies
Interdisciplinary PhD Program Classical Studies
PhD Program
Brief description
The Interdisciplinary PhD Program Classical Studies supports doctoral students in developing interdisciplinary skills and affords them the opportunity to participate in shaping the program.

BENEFRI Neuroscience PhD Program
BENEFRI Neuroscience PhD Program
PhD Program
Brief description
The BENEFRI Neuroscience PhD Program is a specialized program of the Graduate School for Cellular and Biomedical Sciences that provides doctoral candidates with additional training in neuroscience. The basic part of the program is divided into structural and functional neuroscience modules,delivered through a series of neuroscience lectures and exams. The program gives insight into various areas of neuroscience in annually& held workshops.

Doctoral Program for Brain and Behavioral Sciences
Doctoral Program for Brain and Behavioral Sciences
PhD Program
Brief description
The Doctoral Program for Brain and Behavioral Sciences offers a semi-structured, research-centered curriculum with subject-focused courses and annual summer courses for doctoral students, with participation of experienced researchers and doctoral students who explore questions of brain and behavioral science, scientific writing, research methodology and statistics.

Cardiovascular Research PhD Program
Cardiovascular Research PhD Program
PhD Program
Brief description
The Cardiovascular Research PhD Program is a specialized program of the Graduate School for Cellular and Biomedical Sciences that offers doctoral students the opportunity to acquire in-depth training in cardiovascular research. The program includes various teaching formats, some of which are offered by partner universities. The program also supports research stays abroad, networking opportunities and workshops for further professional development.

PhD Program Cell Migration
PhD Program Cell Migration
PhD Program
Brief description
The PhD Program Cell Migration is a specialization program of the Graduate School for Cellular and Biomedical Sciences and is organized by various Swiss research groups in the field of cell migration in morphogenesis, immunosurveillance, inflammation and cancer. The course program consists of, inter alia, lectures, practical courses, journal clubs and annual retreats. It is directed at doctoral students in the fields of biology, biochemistry, (molecular) human and veterinary medicine, immunology, pharmaceutical sciences, chemistry, physics, bioinformatics and mathematics with a focus on life sciences.

PhD Program in Chemistry and Molecular Sciences
PhD Program in Chemistry and Molecular Sciences
PhD Program
Brief description
Doctoral students of the PhD Program in Chemistry and Molecular Sciences benefit from high-quality seminars held by the Department of Chemistry and Biochemistry and nearby institutes. This includes participation in the “First Year Graduate Student Symposium" at the end of the first year, with the chance of winning the “Best Presentation Award”. Every year, it is customary for students to attend a summer school or an international conference to present their work.

Cutting Edge Microscopy PhD Program
Cutting Edge Microscopy PhD Program

The Cutting Edge Microscopy PhD Program is an interdisciplinary specialization program of the Graduate School for Cellular and Biomedical Sciences. The program trains life science students to become researchers with in-depth knowledge of advanced microscopy and image analysis, and with the necessary expertise to develop automated image analysis protocols.

PhD Program in Macro-Finance
PhD Program in Macro-Finance
PhD Program
Brief description
The PhD Program in Macro-Finance equips participating doctoral students with comprehensive knowledge of theoretical and empirical macroeconomics and enables them to analyze and address the intricate feedback loops between financial markets and the real economy. The most important elements of the program include workshops and courses with renowned international researchers.

PhD Program in Problem-Oriented Sports Science
PhD Program in Problem-Oriented Sports Science
PhD Program
Brief description
The inter-university PhD Program in Problem-Oriented Sports Science aims to consolidate supervision through tutors from various sports science sub-disciplines and to promote problem-oriented and interdisciplinary thinking and collaborations. The program also gives participants the opportunity to network with other doctoral students and create international peer groups.

SPAN Doctoral Training in Public Administration
SPAN Doctoral Training in Public Administration
PhD Program
Brief description
The interdisciplinary and inter-university program “Doctoral Training in Public Administration” delivers PhD students of public administration the knowledge required to implement their respective projects in the broad field of public administration. The program focuses on both theoretical and methodological questions and brings participating students together with leading academics in the domain of public administration. This is a joint program of the University of Lausanne, the University of Bern and the Università della Svizzera Italiana (USI).

Public Health Sciences Course Program
Public Health Sciences Course Program
PhD Program
Brief description
The interdisciplinary Public Health Sciences Course Program is an optional program complementary to the offerings of the Graduate School for Health Sciences and the Graduate School for Cellular and Biomedical Sciences. The program offers a broad variety of subject-specific and methodological courses. It is recommended for PhD students focused on public health topics and who want to prepare for a post-doc position in the world of academia or within a science-related organization.
